claims.claim: Anthropic released a research preview of Claude Duet built on Claude Opus 5.5.
claims.episode_span: Anthropic released a research preview of Claude Duet, an app where an AI agent handles tasks for the user in the background even when the user is offline. The system runs on cloud computers and connects to outside services like Gmail, Slack, and Stripe.
claims.source_title: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
claims.supporting_quote: Anthropic has released a preview of "Claude Duet," an app where an AI agent handles tasks for the user in the background. The app runs on cloud computers and connects to outside services like Gmail, Slack, and Stripe.

claims.claim: Claude Duet connects through more than 6,000 connectors and plugins from the Claude Marketplace.
claims.episode_span: It connects to services like Gmail, Slack, Stripe, Docusign, and Shopify through more than 6,000 connectors and plugins from the Claude Marketplace, letting it track unpaid invoices or get payroll ready.

claims.claim: Meta's Muse app now has over 10 million users with shopping as a top activity.
claims.episode_span: Meta's always-on AI app called Muse now has more than 10 million people using it, and shopping is one of the most popular things they do with it.

claims.supporting_quote: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during its Q3 earnings call. The AI app now has over 10M users.
